title: Indian workers fill Germany's labor gaps but face hurdles and risks
summary: The number of Indians working in Germany has grown rapidly in recent years. But many continue to face challenges in the labor market. Some also fall victim to recruitment scams, leaving them vulnerable to exploitation.

title: Polls open in Taiwan's closely watched local elections
summary: Polls have opened for local elections in Taiwan. While campaigners have stayed away from the topic of China and focused on issues like transport and childcare, Beijing has repeatedly weighed in.

title: Spain's Sanchez makes final appeal to voters before election
summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez told people to turn out in large numbers so the country does not go "backwards." Polls suggest an end to his eight-year leftist leadership of Spain.
